exhibits.title: Synthetic Schematic - Building Layout
observations: LAB connects directly to EAST CORRIDOR (shown by teal line)
SERVICE CORRIDOR has UNMONITORED LINK TO LAB (shown by orange line)
CAFETERIA and EAST EXIT shown as separate areas
No LOADING BAY or RECEPTION depicted on this schematic
exhibits.interpretation: V01 establishes spatial relationships. Direct LAB-EAST CORRIDOR link means anyone in the east corridor could access the lab. SERVICE CORRIDOR provides an unmonitored path to the lab.
exhibits.uncertainty: Schematic may not show all corridors or connections; only depicts key areas

exhibits.title: Unverified Witness Statements
observations: Nora: 'I only visited the east corridor and left.'
Eli: 'I did not approach the lab after 18:00.'
Maya: 'I carried a cardboard supply box at 18:11.'
Theo: 'I remained in the cafeteria from 18:12.'
Ada: 'I staffed reception.'
exhibits.interpretation: Statements are unverified. Nora's and Theo's statements align with badge/camera evidence. Eli's statement contradicts V04 (orange coat with prototype at SERVICE DOOR). Maya's statement consistent with V08. Ada's statement consistent with V07.
exhibits.uncertainty: Statements are self-reported and unverified; may be incomplete or inaccurate

exhibits.title: Internal Communications
observations: 17:00 Eli: 'My project needs that prototype tomorrow.'
17:10 Maya: 'Please move the cardboard consumables box to the loading bay.'
17:20 Security: 'Coat descriptions are from shift assignments; doors log badge credentials, not biometric identity. Service camera has a +5 minute clock offset.'
exhibits.interpretation: Eli's message establishes motive (project need). Maya's message about cardboard box is consistent with V08. Security message clarifies critical limitations of all evidence.
exhibits.uncertainty: Messages establish context but not direct involvement in incident

identity_limitations.description: All coat-color identifications derive from shift assignments (per D03 Security message). Badge records log credential use, not biometric identity. Visual snapshots cannot confirm actual person identity.
identity_limitations.impact: Cannot definitively attribute any observed figure to a named individual. Coat colors may be swapped, shared, or outdated. Identity uncertainty applies to all five suspects equally.
identity_limitations.recommendation: Biometric verification required for definitive attribution
